name: InterStellar BBQ
dinnerNote: Barbecue by the pound: brisket and short rib $42, pulled lamb $36, sausages $30; sides from $10
bookingOpens: InterStellar BBQ takes no reservations: there's one queue for eating in and same-day takeaway. It's open Wednesday to Sunday from 11am to 4pm, or until it sells out.
queue: People start queuing around 10am on weekdays and 9:30am at weekends (from 8am on holiday weekends). To get the full menu, arrive at about 10–10:15am on a weekday or 9:15–9:45am at the weekend, and no later than 10:30am. Popular meats start selling out between 1:30pm and 2pm.
walkIns: You can pre-order online for pickup instead of queuing; the link is on the restaurant's home page.
groups: Order and pay before taking a table; please don't hold places in the queue for a big group. For 50 or more, there's catering and private hire.
byob: No alcohol is sold, but if you're 21 or over, with ID, you can bring your own.
